text:
The median asking rent in Bielefeld stands at 10.0 €/m², up 2.9 % year‑on‑year and 24.6 % over the last five years, placing the city 23rd of the 37 most expensive markets. The rent premium over existing contracts is 40 %, while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 600 € per month.

Market tightness is moderate: listings stay on the market for roughly 30 days, 23 % are let within a week, and the vacancy rate is 1.7 %. Rent‑burden for two residents is 13.3 %, indicating limited affordability despite a balanced market balance.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 10.5 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 10.24 €/m² and 10.75 €/m², a 5 % increase.
